acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Johnson City TN PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.

overview:
The Johnson City TN PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. The Johnson City TN PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, the Johnson City TN PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.

success_stories:
Success Story - License Plate Reader (LPR) Technology Assists in Stolen Vehicle Investigation:

On September 1, 2026, a victim reported the suspect of an order of protection violated the order by being present at the victim's house on multiple occasions. On September 2, 2026, an arrest warrant was obtained for the suspect charging him with stalking and contempt of court. Within a few hours of the warrant being obtained, the suspect was located using Flock LPR technology and arrested without incident.

On August 27, 2026, a victim reported her vehicle stolen from a local business parking lot. The following day, Johnson City PD officers used LPR technology to locate the stolen vehicle. Officers conducted a traffic stop and recovered the vehicle. The stolen vehicle was being driven by an individual who was also found to be in possession of methamphetamine. The suspect was arrested for auto theft, driving on a revoked license, and possession of methamphetamine.

See more of our success stories here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1htg3_4kPOuTeLOWWZUTnBG8k0fZbR5UmqZgnNziaQwI/edit?usp=sharing
